title: How dexamethasone turns down inflammation
topic: How dexamethasone binds GR, turns anti-inflammatory genes up and inflammatory genes down, acting upstream of NSAIDs.

claims.claim: Lipophilic dexamethasone slips through the cell membrane to reach cytosolic GR
Dex binds and activates GR; HSP90 chaperone escorts GR to the nuclear pore (newer model)
claims.source: Pratt & Toft, Endocr Rev 1997;18:306-60 (PMID 9183567); Echeverría et al., Mol Cell Biol 2009;29:4788-97 (PMID 19581287)

claims.claim: The drug–receptor complex enters the nucleus
GR dimer on GREs turns anti-inflammatory genes up (annexin A1, MKP-1)
claims.source: Cain & Cidlowski, Nat Rev Immunol 2017;17:233-47 (PMID 28192415); Abraham et al., J Exp Med 2006;203:1883-9 (PMID 16880258)

claims.claim: Tethering NF-κB/AP-1 (plus MKP-1) turns COX-2, IL-1β, TNF-α and IL-6 down
claims.source: Ray & Prefontaine, PNAS 1994;91:752-6 (PMID 8290595); Abraham et al., J Exp Med 2006;203:1883-9 (PMID 16880258)

claims.claim: Mediator output falls over hours, not minutes (watch sweep illustrative)
claims.source: Lösel & Wehling, Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol 2003;4:46-56 (PMID 12511868); timings on screen are schematic

claims.claim: Steroid blocks cPLA₂ step, partly via annexin A1
Steroid: less COX-2 made (COX-1 unaffected); NSAID blocks COX-1 & COX-2 enzyme activity
claims.source: Masferrer et al., PNAS 1994;91:3228-32 (PMID 8159730); Vane, Nat New Biol 1971;231:232-5 (PMID 5284360)

claims.claim: In endodontics, oral/injected steroids reduced post-op pain vs control at 6–24 h (29 RCTs, moderate certainty)
Not a clinical ranking: steroids given only after treatment did not beat placebo for post-op pain

caption:
Why does dexamethasone's anti-inflammatory effect build over hours? It works on gene expression.

Dex enters the cell, binds the glucocorticoid receptor and enters the nucleus.
It turns anti-inflammatory genes up (annexin A1, MKP-1) and NF-κB/AP-1-driven genes down (COX-2, IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6).
So it acts upstream of where NSAIDs block COX (mechanism, not a clinical ranking).
In endo RCTs, systemic steroids cut post-op pain at 6–24 h (moderate certainty); post-op-only dosing didn't beat placebo.

Refs: Cain 2017, Nat Rev Immunol · Alajlan 2024, J Endod · Zanjir 2020, J Endod
